title: SDH-FLUX - Development of a new biomarker for tumor development in patients with SDHx mutation by in vivo fluxomics
official: SDH-FLUX - Development of a new biomarker for tumor development in patients with SDHx mutation by in vivo fluxomics
summary: Main objective: To determine the performance (sensitivity and specificity) of a 13C6-glucose test as a marker for the presence of a constitutional mutation in one of the SDHx genes in a patient with PPGL, compared to genetic testing (reference standard).
conditions: paraganglioma or pheochromocytoma with surgical indication
Neoplasms benign malignant and unspecified (incl cysts and polyps)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men or women over the age of 18
2. Diagnosis of PPGL established based on imaging or metanephrine measurements with a surgical indication
3. Signing the consent form
4. Enrolment in a social security system
Exclusion criteria:
1. Uncontrolled diabetes HbA1c >8%
2. Insulin-treated diabetes
3. Estimated glomerular filtration rate < 30 mL/min/1.73 m² (MDRD formula)
4. Contraindication to glucose administration
5. Pregnancy, breastfeeding
6. Patient under guardianship, conservatorship, or judicial protection
7. Participation in another ongoing clinical trial or one for which the exclusion period has not ended, with the exception of the PREPA PHEO and COMETE CARE studies, which do not interfere with SDH-FLUX research
